properties.name: Jamuna reach near Kazipur, Sirajganj (12 km) — independent evaluation reach
properties.rationale: Second reach for independent evaluation of SAGE-River v2, chosen by the same Sentinel-2 Feb-Mar 2025 vs 2026 reconnaissance (channel-connected outer-bank loss ~65 ha at 30 m); its Sentinel-1 data had not been used when the v2 design was frozen.
